0.1.1-alpha.description:
# Foragipelago v0.1.1
## Bug fixes
### Apworld and client changes
-Create_item() is fixed, UT should work properly now.
-Some progressive Tools are now correctly given.
### Mod changes 
- Level goal option is fully implemented.
- Manually sending an item doesn't flood the chat with an error message.
- The error message about a value not being a string should not randomly spawn anymore.
- Being in a dungeon or inside other structures should not stop most code from running anymore (Untested)
- Removed Old and useless debug functions

## Known issues
-The game randomly crash when exiting to main menu or dying. (Cause is partially known)
-The amount of any Useful or Filler items are janky.
-"Reach Level X" checks are forever missed if the client is disconnected when obtained. 

Backward compability should be a thing with 0.1.0
0.1.1-alpha.title: v0.1.1-alpha

0.2-alpha.description:
# Foragipelago 0.2
## Additions : 
- Added 2 new options : Deathlink and Easier Crafting
- Easier Crafting halves the cost of the most basic of craftable materials (Glass, Coal, Ingots and Thread), this is meant mainly to help short syncs.
- Popups in game when recieving items.
## Changes : 
- Various bug fixes, including :
   - That one out of bounds error spammed when a player recieves too many of a progressive item
   - Hammer, Fishing rod and obliterator not being sent properly
- Logic greatly improved, this include a lot more items being set as progression. Non prog items are still not guarenteed to be in a world, but should be far less of an issue (mainly due to a relative lack of checks currently)
## Known issues : 
 - Game still crash when going back to the main menu (including by dying). This does mean that deathlinks can cause crashes rarely.

This release is likely backwards compatible with previous releases, but is untested, grab the previous release's mod and download it manually if you want to be safe.
